items.title: George Masso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997
items.q: Through Bobby’s help, I went with the Benny Goodman Sextet

ctx.x: Just get away for a week, and go to Raleigh, North Carolina with him and play with a quintet. It was so good that I put in for a year’s leave of absence. I got it. Through Bobby’s help, I went with the Benny Goodman Sextet, and then later on with the World’s Greatest Jazz Band, and I just never went back to teaching because it was a whole new career development.
You were at the college then?
